group: walk(String, InputFormat, boolean, ExecutionContextCustomizer) - Branch Coverage

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because the input string is null
cases.description: Verify that the method validates the mandatory `input` argument and throws an exception when it is null (covers the null‑check branch).

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException thrown because the inputFormat is null
cases.description: Check that a missing `InputFormat` argument is rejected (covers the null‑check branch for the format).

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a parsing error message
cases.description: When deserialization fails (malformed JSON) the method should return a ValidationResult indicating failure (covers the exception‑handling branch inside `deserialize`).

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage entries
cases.description: When `validate` flag is false the schema walk should skip validation and return a successful result (covers the `if (validate)` branch).

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == true and the ExecutionContext contains the custom flag set by the customizer
cases.description: Provide a non‑null `ExecutionContextCustomizer` that mutates the context (e.g., sets a custom attribute). The test verifies that the customizer is invoked (covers the branch where a customizer is present).

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == true (assuming the YAML input is valid for the schema)
cases.description: Exercise the path where a different `InputFormat` (YAML) is supplied and validation succeeds (covers the format‑specific deserialization branch).
When the customizer itself throws an exception, the method should let the exception bubble up (covers the try‑catch / propagation branch).

group: walk(String, InputFormat, boolean, ExecutionContextCustomizer) - Additional Edge & Interaction Cases

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a parsing error message indicating empty input
cases.description: Empty string should be treated as invalid JSON; the method must return a ValidationResult reflecting the deserialization failure.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and a parsing error message indicating whitespace‑only input
cases.description: Whitespace‑only input is not valid JSON; the method should capture the parsing exception and report it in the ValidationResult.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == false and at least one ValidationMessage about an unrecognized keyword
cases.description: A schema containing an unknown keyword should trigger schema validation errors; the method must return those messages.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == true and the ExecutionContext contains attribute customFlag=true
cases.description: Even when validation is disabled, the ExecutionContextCustomizer must still be invoked; this verifies that customizer side‑effects are applied irrespective of the validate flag.

cases.expected: ValidationResult with isValid() == true and no ValidationMessage entries (recursive $ref resolved without infinite recursion)
cases.description: Schema contains a recursive $ref (self‑reference). The walk method should handle recursive anchors correctly and finish without stack overflow or validation errors.
When the customizer throws a different runtime exception (IllegalStateException), the walk method must let it propagate unchanged.
